question: What do iPhone XR buyers say about unlocking, activation, and carrier compatibility?
answer:
One reviewer reported that after inserting a Verizon SIM the phone said "activation required" and Verizon told them it was only half unlocked and still locked to Boost Mobile. [2ceb900cca08_0]
Another reviewer said the phone was advertised as unlocked for any carrier but T-Mobile/Sprint were unable to activate it because the IMEI was for a prepaid phone. [5f991a2a2f3a_0]
A reviewer reported the phone kept asking for an activation code and their carrier said per the IMEI it was not unlocked and was tied to another carrier. [71fe6b3293bf_0]
One buyer said the unlocked version came back as not compatible when they tried to activate it on Verizon. [7dfcdc4dc83d_0]
A reviewer said their carrier (Metro/T-Mobile) informed them the phone was locked to Sprint despite being sold as unlocked. [bff2e622f6e6_0]
Another reviewer stated the device is not compatible with Verizon despite reviews saying it is fully unlocked. [d218873ad7c9_0]

chunks.text: The ad says phones are unlocked but that is not true. Upon receiving the phones, i brought them to my carrier(Verizon) and told when i put my sim card in new phone it says "activation required" Verizon says its only 1/2 unlocked, the phones are still locked to Boost Mobile. and with that being the case i was deceived into buying "unlocked" phones and certainly they are still locked to Boost Mobile. i even went to an authorized Apple dealer and told that these phones were still locked. I have been texting Synergy many times but all they do is ask me the same question "what does the phone say when you insert your old sim card?" I have told Synergy three times the same answer which is "activation required' I still have 2 phones that are locked. Synergy has said nothing else.

Activation issues, works now. Updated*** Arrived early, well packaged, no external issues, only a few very light scratches on front screen, none on back. Problem was with activation. Advertised as an unlocked for any carrier. However T-Mobile/sprint unable to activate this unlocked phone. The IMEI # was for a prepaid phone, so unable to use. Wall plug and cord worked! Waiting on a replacement to arrive. Refund issued, got unlocked replacement and same issue, unable to activate, returned and got a refund, bought another coral colored this time locked for T-Mobile/Sprint. Arrived early, great condition with a screen protector installed. Works great, no complaints. So after all the fiasco, unlocked phones will not work for T-Mobile/Sprint, locked ones to them will.

Feedback. iPhone said it was unlocked. When I tried to get the iPhone set up it kept asking for an activation code. Called my phone carrier and was told that the iPhone was not unlocked per the imei and said the phone was accountable to another phone carrier. Didn’t want to reach out to the other phone carrier to try and unlock a phone that was listed as unlocked. Ended up returning the phone.

NOT unlocked as advertised. Bought the Unlocked version but when we tried to activate on Verizon, it came back as not compatible. Obviously it was not checked or flashed prior to sending out... Verizon support said there was nothing they could do. Then Spent 3 days to get an answer from seller only to learn it would have to be returned, a big inconvenience. The phone itself was in good and packaged well.

Carrier problems. We recently went to our carrier (metro/T-Mobile) to activate the phone . Once we got home I tried started downloading my normal apps and tried to access them and was unable to unless the phone was connected to WIFI. I took it back to the phone store where they informed me it was locked onto a Sprint carrier . We tried going through the settings, factory reset, taking them off the towers and putting them back on and replacing a SIM card. All which went unsuccessful. I am very upset that this phone was sold under false pretenses of being an unlocked phone!

NOT VERIZON COMPATIBLE. Despite all the reviews saying that this device is fully unlocked and compatible with any phone carrier, it is wrong. It is not compatible with Verizon so don't let them scheme you as they did me.
Not what it said. Phone was advertised to be unlocked, however when trying to get it activated with carrier it was not unlocked. Stuck with phone that we can’t use

LOCKED CARRIERS! LOCKED CARRIERS! ALL LOCKED CARRIER FROM THIS SELLER!. THE PRODUCT DOES NOT WORK BECAUSE THE SELLER IS A SCAM. NONE OF THE PHONES THAT SAY "UNLOCKED, OR UNLOCKED FOR ALL CARRIERS" IS TRUE WITH THIS SELLER. AND YOU WILL HAVE TO TAKE IT TO WHOEVER IT IS LOCKED WITH AND PAY THEM DEARLY TO GET THE PHONE RELEASED.

I feel like I wasted my time buying this phone. The phone is running hot and it suppose to be a all carrier unlock phone and I still had to spend more money to get an activation kit because my sim isn’t compatible with this phone smh

I’m not sure the relevance of this either as there is a tracking number on the return label. I respectfully asked for a $20 credit as I would now have to pay two activation fees with my carrier (which actually turned out to be three fees as I needed to reactivate my old phone while waiting for the replacement to come in which equals out to $40 extra I should not be shelling out). I was told they don’t know what an activation fee is, that their phones are all unlocked, and to send proof of the activation fee and they would research it and make a decision. I’m not sure what planet these people are from but it’s definitely not here... Do better.
